objectives.label: Ali je vaš pes prijazen? Ali se lahko povohata?
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask about another dog before they meet.

objectives.label: Potem pa raje ne. Gremo naprej.
objectives.descriptorEN: Back off politely when it isn't a good idea.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Dober dan. Oho, kako se gledajo.
n1.en: Good day. Oh, look at them eyeing each other.
n1.deliverySL: [toplo] Dober dan. Oho, kako se gledajo.

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Ali je vaš pes prijazen?
c1a.en: Good day. Is your dog friendly?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Ali se lahko povohata?
c1b.en: Good day. Can they sniff each other?

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.en: Yes, but he's still a puppy.

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.en: Yes, but he's still a puppy.
c2b.context: her dog is old and shy

c2c.speaker: client
c2c.en: Yes, but he's still a puppy.
c2c.context: her dog doesn't like other dogs

n3ok.speaker: npc
n3ok.sl: Ja, tudi moja je prijazna. Kar naj se povohata.
n3ok.en: Yes, mine's friendly too. Let them have a sniff.
n3ok.deliverySL: [toplo] Ja, tudi moja je prijazna. Kar naj se povohata.

c3a.speaker: client
c3a.context: the dogs sniff and play nicely

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.en: Sorry! He just wants to play.
c3b.context: enzo is far too wild for her dog

n4wild.speaker: npc
n4wild.sl: Nič hudega, saj je še mlad.
n4wild.en: No harm done, he's only young.
n4wild.deliverySL: [toplo] Nič hudega, saj je še mlad.

n3old.speaker: npc
n3old.sl: Oh, moja je pa že stara. Malo je plašna.
n3old.en: Oh, mine's old already. She's a bit shy.
n3old.deliverySL: [oklevajoče] Oh, moja je pa že stara. Malo je plašna.

n3no.speaker: npc
n3no.sl: Moja žal ne mara drugih psov.
n3no.en: Mine doesn't like other dogs, I'm afraid.
n3no.deliverySL: [oklevajoče] Moja žal ne mara drugih psov.

c3o1.speaker: client
c3o1.sl: Potem pa raje ne. Gremo naprej.
c3o1.en: Then better not. We'll move on.

c3o2.speaker: client
c3o2.sl: V redu. Potem pa raje ne.

nByeOn.speaker: npc
nByeOn.sl: Hvala za razumevanje. Pa lep sprehod!
nByeOn.en: Thanks for understanding. Have a nice walk!
nByeOn.deliverySL: [toplo] Hvala za razumevanje. Pa lep sprehod!

nBye.speaker: npc
nBye.sl: Adijo! Še kaj pridite, bo vesela.
nBye.en: Bye! Come by again, she'll be glad.
nBye.deliverySL: [toplo] Adijo! Še kaj pridite, bo vesela.
